📰 General

College Football Coaching Carousel Intensifies: Which Head Coaches Face Firings? •

Several college football programs are facing increased pressure following recent losing seasons and disappointing performances against Power Five opponents. Baylor recently fired head coach Dave Aranda due to a significant decline in team performance. Maryland’s struggles against Power Four teams have placed head coach Mike Locksley under scrutiny. The instability highlights a concerning trend within the college football landscape, raising questions about the future of several head coaches.

🌍 World

Treasury Secretary Claims Trump Sanctions Are Crippling Iran’s Economy •

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent asserts that the Trump administration’s sanctions are significantly damaging Iran’s economy by targeting foreign banking channels. The administration is actively isolating Iran’s financial system as it evaluates further actions against the country. Bessent stated that the sanctions are creating a severe economic crisis within Iran. This intensified pressure reflects Washington’s strategy to weaken the Iranian regime through financial means.

🦅 US

US Marine Charged in Japan with Murder and Robbery of Okinawa Woman •

Japanese prosecutors have formally charged a 20-year-old US Marine, Devin Jacob Ballard, with the murder and robbery of a woman in Okinawa. The charges stem from an incident that occurred while Ballard was stationed on the island. Authorities allege he robbed and killed the woman, though details surrounding the crime remain under investigation. Ballard is currently in custody awaiting further legal proceedings.

💰 Business

Skydance Announces Five-Day In-Office Policy and Voluntary Buyout Program •

Skydance Media is implementing a new policy requiring all employees to work five days a week in the office. As part of this shift, the company is offering a Voluntary Buyout Program (VBO) to employees who wish to leave the company. The move is being spearheaded by co-CEOs David Ellison and Ynon Kreitz, aiming to foster collaboration and strengthen company culture. Details regarding eligibility for the VBO program are still being finalized and will be communicated to staff.

💻 Technology

Instagram Tests 90-Minute Videos, Expanding Content to Apple TV •

Instagram is currently piloting the ability for users to upload and view videos up to 90 minutes in length, a significant increase from its previous limits. This move aims to attract and retain digital creators by offering a more suitable format for longer-form content. Unlike YouTube, Instagram is not currently sharing advertising revenue with creators for these extended videos. The platform is also integrating Reels and other content onto Apple TV, expanding its reach to a new audience. This strategy represents a shift in Instagram’s approach to video content and distribution.

🎭 Entertainment

Zendaya Dominates Met Gala, Showcasing Stunning Custom Valentino Gown •

Zendaya attended the 2024 Met Gala in a breathtaking custom Valentino gown designed by Pierpaolo Piccioli. The dress featured a dramatic, floor-length silhouette with intricate embellishments and a deep V-neckline. She was joined by her partner, Tom Holland, who sported a tailored black suit. The event celebrated “The Garden of Time” and featured a star-studded guest list of celebrities and fashion icons.

🏅 Sports

Baylor Fires Dave Aranda, Initiates Coaching Search Amidst Recruiting Concerns •

Baylor University has terminated the contract of head football coach Dave Aranda following a disappointing 2023 season. The decision comes after the Bears finished with a 12-2 record in 2021, but struggled to maintain that success in subsequent years. The university is now actively seeking replacements, with several prominent coaching candidates reportedly being considered. Baylor’s recruiting outlook is currently uncertain as the program transitions to a new leadership direction.

🔬 Science

Scientists Discover Ancient Microbial Life Deep Beneath Antarctic Ice

Researchers have unearthed evidence of thriving microbial communities in a subglacial lake located nearly a kilometer beneath the West Antarctic Ice Sheet. The discovery, detailed in a new study, reveals a complex ecosystem sustained by chemical energy rather than sunlight. Scientists drilled through the ice to access Mercer Subglacial Lake and collected water and sediment samples. Analysis indicates the organisms are metabolizing methane and ammonia, suggesting a previously unknown biosphere exists in extreme environments. This finding expands our understanding of life’s potential in isolated, dark locations.

🩺 Health

Second Rabid Raccoon Found in Westlake Village – Residents Urged to Be Cautious •

Authorities in Los Angeles County have identified a second raccoon as rabid within the Westlake Village area. The discovery follows a previous finding of a rabid raccoon in the same region, prompting immediate public health warnings. Residents are being advised to avoid all contact with wild animals, particularly raccoons, to prevent potential transmission of the disease. Health officials are continuing to investigate the source of the rabies outbreak and are urging anyone bitten or scratched by an animal to seek immediate medical attention.
